description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.7 side quests, §5.9): after Skarn burned (world.skarn.burned), lift the fallen roof beams back onto two of its burned longhouses - each longhouse's RebuildPoint, a stage-6 giant's errand (world.skarn.longhouse_<n>.rebuilt). 100 XP and Ulfra's support (world.skarn.support: Harrok's talk ending) without the siege's titan iron; Skarn's hearth-forge opens (world.skarn.rebuilt).

stages.objective: Raise the roof beams of two burned longhouses at Skarn
stages.waiting_text: Stand by a burned longhouse's door and lift its roof beams back (stage 6).
